topic: Interior Lighting Sub System - Lamp Breathing Mode and Fade Speed Control
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific breathing rate or fade speed setting for the interior lamp, including its corresponding code value, period (timing), and original breathing mode.

column_semantics.Code 值: The hexadecimal code value that corresponds to a specific breathing rate or fade speed setting.
column_semantics.周期: The time period (in seconds) for the breathing cycle or fade transition.
column_semantics.原呼吸模式值: The original breathing mode value associated with this setting, if applicable.

core_timing_constraints.name: Breathing Period
core_timing_constraints.description: Defined by the 'Period' column, specifying how long each breathing cycle takes (e.g., 500ms, 1s, up to 12s).

core_timing_constraints.name: Fade Speed
core_timing_constraints.description: Defined by the 'Spd' codes, specifying the time it takes to fade between brightness levels (e.g., 300ms, 100ms).

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the parameters for controlling the breathing and fading behavior of the interior ambient lamps. It specifies how different code values correspond to specific timing intervals for breathing modes and fade speeds, which can be used to test the responsiveness and accuracy of the lighting system under various command inputs.
